flow.name: notify-order-registered-flow
flow.doc:description: Order confirmation: gets the customer and, when it has an email, sends it through MagicBell

set-variable.doc:description: Keeps the event: the HTTP calls replace the payload

logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'INIT - order.registered email, orderId: ' ++ (vars.event.orderId default 'n/a') ++ ' correlationId: ' ++ correlationId]
logger.doc:description: Logs the start. The customer email is not logged

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- do { import orderRegisteredEmail from modules::notifications --- orderRegisteredEmail(vars.event, vars.customer) }]

flow-ref.name: customer-email-send-subflow
flow-ref.doc:description: Sends it, or skips when the customer has no email

sub-flow.name: notify-approval-requested-subflow
sub-flow.doc:description: approval.requested: tells the approver that a correction is waiting for a decision

set-variable.doc:description: Keeps the event: the HTTP calls replace the payload

logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'INIT - approval.requested email, requestId: ' ++ (vars.event.requestId default 'n/a') ++ ' correlationId: ' ++ correlationId]

try.doc:description: The approver is told even when the customer is not found

on-error-continue.doc:description: Uses the customer id instead of the name

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- do { import approvalRequestedEmail from modules::notifications --- approvalRequestedEmail(vars.event, vars.customer.name, p('notifications.approverEmail')) }]

sub-flow.name: notify-correction-applied-subflow
sub-flow.doc:description: correction.applied: the only customer email of a correction (D18)

set-variable.doc:description: Keeps the event: the HTTP calls replace the payload

logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'INIT - correction.applied email, requestId: ' ++ (vars.event.requestId default 'n/a') ++ ' correlationId: ' ++ correlationId]
logger.doc:description: Logs the start. The customer email is not logged

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- do { import correctionAppliedEmail from modules::notifications --- correctionAppliedEmail(vars.event, vars.customer) }]

flow-ref.name: customer-email-send-subflow
flow-ref.doc:description: Sends it, or skips when the customer has no email

choice.doc:description: 404 means the customer does not exist

raise-error.doc:description: Permanent error: answered as 404 and rejected to the DLQ

sub-flow.name: customer-email-send-subflow
sub-flow.doc:description: Sends vars.mail when the customer has an email; otherwise the result is SKIPPED

choice.doc:description: Without an email there is nobody to write to

logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'WARN - Customer without email, ' ++ (vars.mail.category default 'email') ++ ' skipped, orderId: ' ++ (vars.event.orderId default 'n/a') ++ ' correlationId: ' ++ correlationId]

sub-flow.name: broadcast-send-subflow
sub-flow.doc:description: POST /broadcasts with vars.mail, redirected to notifications.redirectTo in the demo (D11). Result: NotificationResult SENT

set-variable.doc:description: redirectTo when set, otherwise the real recipient
set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- do { import recipientFor from modules::notifications --- recipientFor(vars.mail.to, p('notifications.redirectTo')) }]

http:request.doc:description: POST /broadcasts in MagicBell with the project token
http:request.http:body: #[output application/json --- do { import broadcast from modules::notifications --- broadcast(vars.mail, vars.recipient) }]

choice.doc:description: The HTTP connector has no error type for 422: it becomes a business error

raise-error.doc:description: Permanent error: answered as 502 PROVIDER_REJECTED and rejected to the DLQ

set-payload.doc:description: NotificationResult SENT with the recipient and the broadcast id
set-payload.value: #[output application/json --- do { var id = payload.id default payload.broadcast.id --- { status: 'SENT', recipient: vars.recipient, (broadcastId: id) if (id != null) } }]

logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'END - ' ++ (vars.mail.category default 'email') ++ ' sent, broadcastId: ' ++ (payload.broadcastId default 'n/a') ++ ' correlationId: ' ++ correlationId]
logger.doc:description: Logs the sent email. The recipient is not logged
